QuestInfo.name: Human Enough
QuestInfo.0: #p2159393# confesses that she was going to be scrapped as a failure if you were not defeated.\r\n#p2159393# has returned to Gelimer, even though she knows what will happen. You tried to convince her to stay, but she would not listen. She almost appeared to be smiling... Go to #bRoo-D#k.
QuestInfo.2: Roo-D believes that Beryl is gone, but she will continue looking. The pain you feel now may be evidence of your human emotions returning. It's hard to believe that humans can deal with this much pain in their hearts...
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Speak with Roo-D in the Veritas labs.

yes.0: I can't give up like this! Maybe Roo-D can help me figure out what happened and find Beryl.

1.0: What is it, #h0#? What happened with Beryl?\r\n#L0##b(You tell Roo-D everything.)#l\n#k
1.1: I see...\r\n#L0##bRoo-D, we have to find Beryl? Actually, no! I'm going to find Gelimer. She'll be with him.#l\n#k
1.2: You can't! The Black Wings facility is the only thing left in Verne Mine! Gelimer kept our existence a SECRET from the Black Wings. He won't be running around with a Xenoroid in the open. They have to be hiding in a lab.\r\n#L0##bWe have to find them!#l\n#k
1.3: Let me and the others in the lab find Beryl. Old Gelimer's way too smart to toss out a completed Xenoroids like Beryl so long as he doesn't have you and me. We have the upper hand here.\r\n#L0##bWhat do I do? This feeling is just so... painful.#l\n#k
1.4: You're feeling sad, #h0#. Your emotions are coming back. Maybe you're becoming more human!\r\n#L0##bI-I don't know if I can handle it...#l\n#k
1.5: You have to! This is what you wanted! Just think, were you this sad when you escaped? Or when you had to leave Edelstein? You're growing. You're learning to be human again... and part of being human is feeling loss.\r\n#L0##bIs being human always so wretched and painful?#l\n#k
1.6: I don't know. But I do know that being happy and being sad are two sides of the same coin. Gelimer may have tried to erase your feelings to make you perfect, but he was wrong. Knowing pain and suffering are what make happiness worth fighting for.

yes.0: I know this has to be a lot to handle, but you can do it. You have to. In the meantime, I promise you, I'll find Beryl.

npc.0: I must find Roo-D, she might be able to locate Beryl.
